content.text:
Needed: A switch or a router with a spare wired port for Home server for photos
Kind of part: Any item
Top price: 30 USD

request.instructions: You plan a search of second-hand listings for one needed part or device. Write 3 to 6 search phrasings a seller might have put in a listing title: the plain name, synonyms, the part or model number in the ways it gets written, the devices it is sold for, seller wording and common misspellings; each with one line on what it finds that the others miss. A phrasing is a few words for a search box that takes words, not operators or quotes. Then one match pattern: an RE2 regular expression, applied case-insensitively to a listing's text, that a listing which fits the need matches, built from the part number with optional separators or the deciding values with their units. Keep it under 200 characters; use short gaps such as .{0,20} and classes such as [-\s]?; no lookarounds, no backreferences, no comments and no inline flags. Then the words or short phrases in a listing that rule it out: for parts, broken, not working, and any that name a variant that does not fit. Never invent a part or model number the need does not give.

content.text: {"exclusions": ["broken", "not working", "damaged", "for parts", "hdmi switch", "kvm switch", "light switch", "no power adapter"], "pattern": "(switch|router).{0,20}(port|ethernet|lan|gigabit|wired)", "phrasings": [{"text": "network switch", "url": "https://www.facebook.com/marketplace/search/?query=network%20switch", "why": "Finds plain-name wired switch listings that router-worded listings miss."}, {"text": "ethernet switch", "url": "https://www.facebook.com/marketplace/search/?query=ethernet%20switch", "why": "Finds sellers who describe by wired port type instead of just network switch."}, {"text": "wifi router", "url": "https://www.facebook.com/marketplace/search/?query=wifi%20router", "why": "Finds routers with spare LAN ports that pure switch searches miss."}, {"text": "gigabit router", "url": "https://www.facebook.com/marketplace/search/?query=gigabit%20router", "why": "Finds faster wired-port models good for photo server transfers."}, {"text": "ethernet swtich", "url": "https://www.facebook.com/marketplace/search/?query=ethernet%20swtich", "why": "Finds misspelled titles that correct-spelling searches never return."}]}
